activities.description: Kung Lao walks with a comrade. Kung Lao talks about regretting losing his comrades. Kung Lao fights with two comrades in an arena.

characterInteraction.description: Kung Lao is the only character present for most of the scene. There is a brief interaction with a comrade before his execution, but it lacks depth.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The scene suggests that Kung Lao is now aligned with the forces of the Netherrealm, as he is killing his former comrades.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Transition from black screen to a city scene with ominous music, establishing a tense and potentially angry mood.
Transition from city scene to Kung Lao walking with a comrade, with an emphasis on Kung Lao's sorrowful expression and voice, introducing notes of sadness.

narrativeProgression.description: Kung Lao expresses regret over the loss of his comrades.
Kung Lao executes one comrade using his blade.
Kung Lao executes another comrade using his blade.

scenes.title: Scene 1

videoEditingDetails.description: Fade in at 0:05. Fade out at 0:08.
Ominous music starts at 0:05 and continues throughout the scene.
Slow-motion effect is used during Kung Lao's fight scenes.
The segment where Kung Lao walks with his comrade (0:05-0:08) could be removed to make the scene more dynamic as it adds little to the overall narrative.

activities.description: Liu Kang fights against a man in a destroyed city.

characterInteraction.description: Liu Kang is engaged in a violent confrontation with another man, showcasing his current aggression and lack of mercy.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Liu Kang's corruption is visually emphasized by his glowing red eyes, symbolizing his alignment with the Netherrealm.

narrativeProgression.description: A fight between Liu Kang and another man begins.
Liu Kang delivers the final blow, ending the fight.

scenes.title: Scene 2

videoEditingDetails.description: Fade in from black screen at 0:24. Title card 'The Shaolin Clan' appears at 0:24. Fade out at 0:29.
Intense fighting music starts at 0:24 and continues throughout the scene.
Slow-motion and close-up shots emphasize the brutality of the fight.

activities.description: Liu Kang fights and kills two individuals. Kung Lao watches the fight.

characterInteraction.description: Liu Kang is shown as a ruthless killer, while Kung Lao acts as a sinister observer, suggesting a master-servant dynamic.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Liu Kang's brutality and Kung Lao's eerie calmness highlight the profound corruption caused by the Netherrealm, making them formidable antagonists.

keyMoments.changeDescription: The scene cuts to a fight between Liu Kang and Sub-Zero, showing a shift in opponent and raising the stakes.

narrativeProgression.description: Liu Kang fights and kills Sub-Zero.
Liu Kang fights and kills another man.
Kung Lao expresses his loyalty to the Netherrealm.

props.name: A spiked club and hat used by Kung Lao.

scenes.title: Scene 3

videoEditingDetails.description: Fade in from black screen at 0:31. Title card 'Liu Kang' appears at 0:31. Cut to a new scene at 0:32. Fade out at 0:40. Title card 'Kung Lao' appears at 0:42.
Continues with the intense fighting music.
Slow-motion, close-ups, and dramatic camera angles are used to highlight the action.

activities.description: Kung Lao fights against another man in a temple setting.

characterInteraction.description: Kung Lao demonstrates his dominance and cruelty in a one-sided fight.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Kung Lao's fight takes place in a temple, showcasing a desecration of a sacred place, symbolizing the corruption of his soul.

narrativeProgression.description: A fight between Kung Lao and another man begins.
Kung Lao throws his opponent into the water, presumably killing him.

props.name: A large circular blade used by Kung Lao.

scenes.title: Scene 4

videoEditingDetails.description: Fade in from black screen at 0:43. Cut to a new scene at 0:45. Fade out at 0:46.

activities.description: Sub-Zero fights a horde of Lin Kuei warriors. Kung Jin fights various enemies and shoots an arrow into a man's head. Bo' Rai Cho fights enemies in a jungle. Sub-Zero fights Kung Jin.

characterInteraction.description: The scene shows a power struggle between different factions. Kung Jin and Sub-Zero engage in a tense confrontation before a deadly fight.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Kung Jin's willingness to kill Sub-Zero suggests a potential shift in alliances, hinting at the complex moral landscape of the world.

keyMoments.changeDescription: The scene transitions from bright visuals to a darker setting with snow falling, adding a sense of danger and urgency.
The scene shifts to a jungle setting with vibrant colors and a slightly slower pace, momentarily offering a less intense mood before the action resumes.

narrativeProgression.description: Sub-Zero confronts a horde of Lin Kuei warriors.
Kung Jin steps forward to speak with Sub-Zero.
Kung Jin fights several Lin Kuei warriors.
Kung Jin shoots an arrow into a man's head.
Bo' Rai Cho battles enemies in the jungle.

props.name: Arrows, a staff, a giant metal shield, a bull statue.

scenes.title: Scene 5

videoEditingDetails.description: Cut to a new scene with bright visuals at 0:46. Cut to a new scene at 0:48. Title card 'Kung Jin' appears at 1:03. Cut to a new scene at 1:15. Fade out at 1:17. Cut to a new scene at 1:18. Cut to a new scene at 1:21. Fade out at 1:29. The screen turns completely black at 1:32.
The music remains intense and fast-paced throughout the fighting scenes.
Slow-motion, close-ups, and dramatic camera angles emphasize the brutality of the fights.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The final scene implicitly promises players the opportunity to experience the intense action and brutality depicted in the narrative scenes.
scenes.title: Scene 6

videoEditingDetails.description: Cut to a black screen with white text 'Mortal Kombat X', 'Available Digitally & In Stores', and '04.14.2015' at 1:32. Fade to black at 1:34. Cut to a black screen with a small white figure moving upwards at 1:38. Cut to a video game box set at 1:40. Text 'Mortal Kombat X Collector’s Edition by COARSE' appears at the bottom of the screen. Cut to scenes from the game at 1:50. Text 'For More MKX' appears in the top right corner of the screen at 1:51 and stays until the end of the scene. Three buttons 'PRE-ORDER NOW', 'KOLLECTIVE', and 'YOUTUBE' are displayed below with their descriptions.
An energetic and exciting rock music track starts at 1:38 and continues throughout the scene.
